title: gray ceramic asian spoons
text: gray ceramic asian spoons. These are really nice.  They do have a gray tinge to them - but I think they are neutral enough to use with lots of different colors.  They are thick, but not really heavy.  I put them in my top dishwasher special care wash rack and they washed no problem.  They are average sized as asian spoons go.  If you're looking to use these for appetizer bites, they don't stand flat at the base of the spoon - they lay flat in a way you'd have trouble getting anything to stay in the bowl.  If that makes sense.  I am using them for soup so I'm ok with that.  Arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition along with other items I had ordered.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
